prompt: Which interstate war has had the highest estimated number of combat deaths since World War II?
answer: The **Korean War (1950–1953)** is generally estimated to have had the highest death toll of any interstate war since World War II—roughly **2.6 to 4.1 million deaths** in some comprehensive estimates. Estimates vary depending on whether civilian deaths from war-related famine, disease, and displacement are included.
